theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → R.Represents C → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection x = x
